treasure_table.note: Character has no gold or possessions

news.text: No news of note, nothing seems to be happening.
Discover thieves' den, pillage it while they're out, gain 50 gold.
Rumours of secret rites at nearest temple, when making offerings (r212) there add one (+1) to your dice roll from now on.
Feel at home, learning nothing, but in the future always add one (+1) whenever resolving this action (r209) or Seeking to Hire (r210) in this hex.
A large caravan is in town; if you visit them today, see e129.
Discover cheaper lodgings and food, pay half normal price in this hex
A cutpurse picks your pocket; you lose half your wealth.
Attract attention of local constabulary; see e050.
Discover residence of local magician. If you visit him today, see e016 with a friendly approach.

Discover local thieves' guild, you are "invited" to join. If you do, participate in a theft of 200 gold tonight after dinner (r215). You must escape (r218) tonight after the job. If you pay the guild 10% (20 gold) after the theft you can return to the hex later in the game, otherwise the guild is angered and you can never return to this hex.
Secret informant offers valuable information for 10 gold. If you buy it, roll one die: 1-bogus secrets prove worthless; 2-e147; 3-e143; 4-e144; 5-e145; 6-e146.

hiring.text: Freeman joins your part at no cost (except food and lodging), he is combat skill 3, endurance 4.
Lancer with a horse can be hired for 3 gold per day, he is combat skill 5, endurance 5.
One or two mercenaries can be hired for 2 gold per day each. Each is combat skill 4, endurance 4.
Horse dealer in area, you can buy horses (for mounts) at 10 gold each.
Local guide available (see r205), hires for 2 gold per day, has combat skill 2, endurance 3.
Henchmen available, roll one die for the number available for hire, each is combat skill 3, endurance 3, and costs 1 gold per day each.
Nothing available, but you gain some news and information, see r209 but subtract one (-1) from your dice roll there.
Honest horse dealer in area, can buy horses (for mounts) at 7 gold each.
Runaway boy or girl joins your party at no cost (except food and lodging), has combat skill 1, endurance 3.
Porters in any quantity available, hire for gold each per day. In addition, a local guide (r205) can be hired for 2 gold per day, has combat skill 1, endurance 2.

offerings.text: You commit a magnificent error in the rites, the entire temple becomes impure and abandoned, no longer functions as a temple for the rest of the game. You are arrested and sentenced to death, e061.
Good Omens, but no special result.

Bad Omens, you are travelling under a curse. Roll one die for each of your followers, any result except a "1" means they believe the omens and immediately desert you. You cannot seek to hire any followers (r210) in this hex for the rest of the game.
High Priest insulted by your northern manners, arrested e060.
Good Omens, you get free food (r215) and lodging (r217) tonight.
Favourable Omens for further worship, if you try this Offerings action again tomorrow, you can add one (+1) to your dice roll. Otherwise no effect.
Gods favour your questions, priests assign a monk to your party. The monk has combat skill 2, endurance 3, serves as a guide when leaving this or any adjacent hex only.
Special omen and riddle provides a clue to treasures, see e147.

Fall in love with priestess (see r229). You immediately escape (r218) with her and can never return to this hex. She is combat skill 2, endurance 4, and has wealth 100 in temple treasures she has stolen!
The High Priest requires an audience with you; see e155.

High Priest spends afternoon talking with you, provides you with final clues to some secret information, roll one die: 1,2-e144; 3,4-e145; 5,6-e146. Alternately, instead of the secret information, you can use his influence in attempting Offerings again tomorrow, and add three (+3) to your dice roll here.

Gods declare your cause a religious crusade, and the Staff of Command is passed into your hands. If you bring this possession to any hex north of the Tragoth River you will command instant obedience throughout the Northlands, regain your throne and win the game. In the meantime you are given a pair of warrior monks (combat skill 5, endurance 6) with mounts to join your party and help you return northward.

cache_recovery.text: Cache is found intact; you recover all items placed there.
You are unable to find the cache, landmarks have disappeared, but you can try again in the future.
You find the cache, but it has been looted, there is nothing there.

trap_locks.text: Poison needle inflicts one poisoned wound.
Burning acid explodes; roll one die for the number of wounds suffered.
Poison gas bursts. Roll one die for the number of poison wounds suffered.

Plague dust inflicts a sickness. Roll one die and halve the result, rounding upward. You suffer these many wounds at the end of the day. You will continue to suffer the same number after every day, until you recover. To determine recovery, roll one die after the sickness wounds are inflicted. If this second roll is 4 or higher, you recover. Otherwise, sickness continues.
Flying spikes and knives explode toward you. Roll one die and add three (+3) for the number of wounds suffered.

Bandits, who may surprise you, see r308.
Arrogant and surly, the conversation turns into an argument, r305.
Character(s) needs 10 gold now, r331; if they join, they will leave your party in a next town, castle or temple you enter in any event.
Character(s) ask for 5 gold now and employment, see r332.
Character(s) willing to hire as henchmen, see r333.

Character(s) down on luck, looking for a turn in fortunes, see r336.
Character(s) obviously plundering mercenaries, see r340.
Character(s) discover a common cause with you; see r334.

errata.correction: Dice roll results for '4' and '5' should be interchanged, dice roll result '9' should refer to e050, and dice roll result '11' should reference rule r218 for escape.
Dice roll '12' porters have combat skill 1, endurance 2.
Dice roll result '12' should be '12, 13' while dice roll result '13 (or higher)' should read '14 (or higher)' instead.
In r215c, a dice roll result of '6' should reference e050, with two added (+2) to the die roll in that event.
In the last paragraph of this rule, fourth line, the reference to combat r220 should be r306 instead.

In strikes (r220c), when facing multiple opponents, a character can strike at only one each round, but can select which one to strike against. Example on the next page is wrong; the Dwarf should roll a '10' and with modifiers result in an '8' to inflict one wound.
Raid result: Combat reference in second line should be r306. The fight against the family itself (if you get that far) should have a reference to r305 to set up the combat situation for that.
Friendly Approach: Magician is combat skill 3, endurance 5 (in case he joins your party).
Die roll result of '1' with 'fight' choce should lead to 'surprise r301.' Note that the die roll for desertion due to mark of Cain is made with just one die.

Introductory paragraph is completely wrong. It should read: You encounter a person trying to avoid local justice. He or she will join your party as an ally, but will desert whenever you encounter any Constables (unless your party elects to fight them, and kills them all) or whenever you enter any town, castle, or temple. Instead, you can immediately elect to fight the character encountered, see r300. Roll one die to see exactly who you meet:
Second paragraph is misplaced; ignore it completely; this event is solely contained in the first paragraph.
In second paragraph, second line, reference to victim selection should be r341, not r143.
If you fall and survive your wounds (second paragraph), roll one die to see if your party finds you.
The eagle who joins is combat skill 4, endurance 3.
All characters recover from sunstroke at the evening meal.
Die roll result of '4', if you agree to make offerings, you only add two (+2) to die roll on r212; do not add three. [Word file provided by David Bate]
